## Lesson 3 — Select the probe-compensated two-Port View {#lesson-ch4-ptc}

### Compare the original loaded View with its PTC derivation

The original loaded operator includes all four declared Port loads. For the
public raw four-Port S/Y/Z network, SCNSim de-embeds source admittances at the
selected scattering boundary; those matrices are not the loaded operator.
PTC removes only the two named probe load stamps, and `retain()` selects the
two feedline coordinates for the requested scattering boundary. Retention
alone does not unload the omitted probes or measurement Ports. See
[Simulation conventions](../../../docs/concepts/simulation-conventions.qmd#loads-and-selected-views)
for this distinction and the common View authority for S, Y, and Z.

```{python}
#| id: ch4-derive-ptc-view
run = CircuitRun(plan=plan, storage="memory")
raw_loaded_view = run.original
raw_transmission_trace = SParameterTrace(
    id="transmission",
    input_port="feedline_in",
    input_mode=(),
    output_port="feedline_out",
    output_mode=(),
)
raw_direct_spec = DirectSolveSpec(
    frequencies=[5.5, 6.0, 6.5] * u.GHz,
    traces=(raw_transmission_trace,),
)

ptc_view = raw_loaded_view.reduce(
    ReductionPipeline()
    .ptc(probe_plus, probe_minus)
    .retain("feedline_in", "feedline_out")
)

ptc_transmission_trace = SParameterTrace(
    id="transmission",
    input_port="feedline_in",
    input_mode=(),
    output_port="feedline_out",
    output_mode=(),
)
ptc_direct_spec = DirectSolveSpec(
    frequencies=[5.5, 6.0, 6.5] * u.GHz,
    traces=(ptc_transmission_trace,),
)
```

These three frequencies are exact declared samples, not a continuous scan or
a resonance locator.

```{python}
#| id: ch4-solve-ptc-direct
raw_direct = run.solve(raw_loaded_view, raw_direct_spec)
raw_transmission = raw_direct.traces["transmission"]
ptc_direct = run.solve(ptc_view, ptc_direct_spec)
ptc_transmission = ptc_direct.traces["transmission"]
display(raw_direct.s.view)
from IPython.display import display

def present_s21(trace):
    magnitude_plot = trace.plot(component="magnitude", magnitude="db")
    phase_plot = trace.plot(component="phase")
    for figure, component, unit in (
        (magnitude_plot, "magnitude", "dB"),
        (phase_plot, "phase", "deg"),
    ):
        figure.update_traces(
            mode="lines+markers", line={"color": "#246398", "width": 2},
            marker={"color": "#246398", "size": 7},
            hovertemplate="%{x:.6g} GHz<br>%{y:.6g} " + unit + "<extra></extra>",
        )
        figure.update_layout(
            template="plotly_white", autosize=True, height=340, showlegend=False,
            title={"text": f"S21 {component}", "x": .02, "xanchor": "left", "font": {"size": 18}},
            font={"family": "Arial, sans-serif", "size": 14, "color": "#243344"},
            margin={"l": 78, "r": 24, "t": 55, "b": 62},
            paper_bgcolor="white", plot_bgcolor="white",
        )
        figure.update_xaxes(title_text="Frequency (GHz)", ticks="outside", showline=True,
                            linecolor="#6f7b85", gridcolor="#e5e9ed", zeroline=False,
                            automargin=True, title_standoff=12)
        figure.update_yaxes(title_text=f"{component.capitalize()} ({unit})", ticks="outside",
                            showline=True, linecolor="#6f7b85", gridcolor="#e5e9ed",
                            zeroline=False, automargin=True, title_standoff=12)
    display(magnitude_plot)
    display(phase_plot)
present_s21(raw_transmission)
display(ptc_direct.s.view)
present_s21(ptc_transmission)
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

Port 1 is `feedline_in` and Port 2 is `feedline_out`; this S21 trace maps input Port 1 to output Port 2 at 5.5, 6.0 and 6.5 GHz.
